title: ‘Things I think’ about Giants-Cowboys: ‘Unbelievable environment’ best sign of all

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ‘Things I think’ about Giants-Cowboys: ‘Unbelievable environment’ best sign of all
sources.description: EAST RUTHERFORD, N.J. — That was different. Yes, the simple fact that the New York Giants won a season-opener on Sunday night was different. The Giants had lost six of seven season-opening games against the Dallas Cowboys prior to Sunday’s impressive 28-20 victory. They had started 10 of the 13 previous seasons 0-2 or worse. […]
